company_name: Foshan Shunde Topcod Industrial Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: Low — the company primarily produces desiccant agents and related materials, which are not directly involved in semiconductor manufacturing or processing.
summary: Foshan Shunde Topcod Industrial Co., Ltd specializes in the production of high-efficient desiccant agents, which are used for moisture control in various applications. While they serve electronic companies, their products do not directly contribute to semiconductor fabrication or assembly processes.

regional_presence.China: The company has established a manufacturing base in South China and serves customers primarily in Guangdong and Hong Kong.
